title: SPECTATOR DON'T LAST LONG (178)
style: happy hardcore, UK hardcore revival, 178 BPM, instrumental with chipmunk-pitched vocal chops only (no lead vocal, no rap), supersaw stack detuned wide, hoover bass stabs, four-on-the-floor pounding kick, snare rolls, sidechain pumping everything to the kick, defiant urgent energy, raised-fist crowd anthem, euphoric breakdown into double-time drop, festival mainstage 2026 production, no profanity, no real-artist references
lyrics:
[Intro — 0:00 — pads, sub swell, faint kick pulse, distant crowd]
(chop, +6) "Spectator"
(chop, +6) "Don't — last — long"
(chop, +6) "Doer — ships"
(chop, +6) "Keel — moves"

[Build — 0:16 — hoover roll, riser, snare 4/8/16/32]
(chant, up) "Spectator — spectator — spectator — GONE"
(chant, down) "Doer — doer — doer — SHIPS"
(chant, up) "Finich — not — finish"
(riser hold)

[Drop 1 — 0:32 — full hardcore, supersaws wide, kick fours]
(stacked) "SPECTATOR — DON'T — LAST — LONG!"
(call) "DOER — SHIPS!"
(stacked) "KEEL — MOVES!"
(call) "G4 — LENS — ON!"
(stacked) "FINICH — NOT — FINISH!"

[Verse — 1:04 — half-time, piano + saw stabs]
(chop run) "Watcher — in — the — stands"
(chop run) "Worker — on — the — floor"
(chop run) "Mansion — won't — wait"
(chop run) "Three — three — six — moves"
(chop run) "Spectator — turns — to — dust"

[Breakdown — 1:36 — strip to piano + lone chop, no kick]
(chop, slow, +8) "Three..."
(chop) "Three..."
(chop) "Six..."
(chop, fading) "Doer — ships"
(riser, white noise, snare roll)

[Drop 2 — 2:00 — double-time, full euphoria]
(wall) "SPECTATOR — DON'T — LAST — LONG!"
(wall) "DOER — SHIPS — TONIGHT!"
(wall) "KEEL — MOVES — ON!"
(wall) "G4 — LENS — LOCKED!"
(wall) "FINICH — NOT — FINISH!"

[Outro — 2:32 — fade on chop + sub]
(chop, fading, +6) "Spectator don't last long..."
(chop, fading) "Doer ships..."
(chop, fading) "Keel moves..."
(sub pulse out)
